csrfCookie.name: cvg_csrf
csrfCookie.description: Readable double-submit CSRF cookie. Authenticated mutations require this cookie and the matching X-CSRF-Token header.

CorrelationId.description: Stable correlation identifier for support and audit tracing.

x-cross-field-constraints: ward and bed are only accepted for encounterType=INPATIENT

timezone.x-runtime-validation: IANA time zone identifier validated by Intl.DateTimeFormat

x-role-constraints.managedDepartmentCodes: allowed only when role is MANAGER
allowed only when role is MANAGER

x-cross-field-constraints: when category and workflowType are both supplied, LABORATORY requires LABORATORY and IMAGING requires RADIOLOGY or ULTRASOUND
when only one field is supplied, compatibility is evaluated against the persisted counterpart
endsAt - startsAt must be at most 24 hours
